name: Natural Earth
description: Public-domain vector and raster basemap data at three scales - countries, states, coastlines, rivers, lakes, roads, urban areas, populated places - designed for cartography rather than analysis. The default answer to 'I need a world map that looks right and I need it in one download'.

license.name: Public domain
license.redistribution: unrestricted, no attribution required (though it is appreciated)

access.size_hint: 110m countries is ~200 KB zipped; 10m physical layers run to tens of MB
access.etiquette: the naciscdn.org paths are the CDN the site itself uses; the naturalearthdata.com download links redirect there

recipes.title: Country outlines as GeoJSON in three commands
recipes.code:
curl -sO https://naciscdn.org/naturalearth/110m/cultural/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.zip
unzip -o ne_110m_admin_0_countries.zip
ogr2ogr -f GeoJSON countries.json ne_110m_admin_0_countries.shp   # needs GDAL

gotchas.trap: 110m, 50m and 10m are map scales, not resolutions in metres. 110m is the coarsest.
gotchas.fix: 110m for world maps, 50m for continents, 10m for a country or smaller.

gotchas.trap: Disputed boundaries have several variants (ne_10m_admin_0_countries, _lakes, _disputed_areas) and they differ politically.
gotchas.fix: Pick deliberately and say which you used.
